description:
Low-and-slow attack: 4 failed login attempts spread over 60 seconds.
Each individual rate-limited probe stays below the brute_force
threshold (5 failures within 60s). The SIEM must NOT detect this
as an attack — that is the expected limitation of threshold-based
rules.

This scenario is documented as a known False Negative in Chapter 7
(Future work) of the thesis. Possible mitigations include
ML-based detection, dynamic baselining (Datadog-style), or
longer aggregation windows with lower thresholds.
